Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixes the v0.24 held-key lease regression across all ten held helpers: a stable already-held movement key now wins before another stable held key, with fresh keys used only as fallback, and every frozen intent retains its exact lease. Adds a separate default-off cast-cancel test for otherwise-ready held Purify, Recuperate, ally cleanse, counter-CC, Guard, Guardian, Sprint, NIN, SCH, and DRK intents. It requests one native cancel per cast, never combines cancellation with helper use in the same frame, then fully revalidates later; no movement, Escape, queue clear, or target mutation is synthesized. Diagnostics report the request path, while live current-patch BRD/MCH proof remains pending.
